abstract: Create, upgrade or align ScaleDock product, library and tooling repos against one standard: the latest Node that Vercel supports, latest pnpm and the stable native TypeScript compiler, a strict Turborepo workspace, Next.js surfaces or a universal Expo app, an optional native-only Expo mobile app with PowerSync for offline data, Supabase with better-supabase, PermDock, an oRPC contract shared by the API, MCP and CLI, Fumadocs, and Vercel-first infrastructure. Every type-aware oxlint rule runs at error, Valibot covers every schema, and Temporal is the one date library. Agents verify Next.js work through the dev server's MCP endpoint and keep the tool-managed AGENTS.md blocks committed. Upgrade and align modes fill a gap table from a fixed checklist with a fixed status vocabulary, and every run ends with a report template; every version is looked up at run time. SKILL.md holds the inputs, ground rules, workflow and final checklist, and each area of the standard lives in its own reference so the agent loads only what the repo kind and selected surfaces need.
